newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa hopes to postpone offering - source.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa hopes to postpone offering - source.

text.p: The board of directors of steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) will propose modifications to the company's forthcoming global offering, an executive told Reuters on Wednesday.
The executive, who asked not to be named, said Ahmsa's main aim was to delay the timing for the offering. The Ahmsa board will propose modifications at a shareholders meeting on Wednesday.

The original conditions for the offering, approved September 17, were to offer up to 70 million shares before the close of 1996 and a further 55 million before the close of 1997, depending on market conditions.
Ahmsa had ruled out an offering before the end of this year due to conditions in the world steel market, the director of the company's coal-mining arm, Guillermo Ancira Elizondo, said on October 9.
